title: Keys and Rooms
summary: Given n rooms numbered from 0 to n-1, with room 0 unlocked, you must determine if all rooms can be visited.
statement: Given n rooms numbered from 0 to n-1, with room 0 unlocked, you must determine if all rooms can be visited. Each room contains a unique set of keys that unlock other rooms. Return true if all rooms can be accessed, otherwise return false.
constraints: Room zero starts unlocked; keys found in visited rooms unlock named rooms.
Return whether all rooms become reachable.
hints: Rooms and keys form a directed reachability graph.
Run DFS or BFS from room zero and mark every newly unlocked room.
Pop a room, add unseen keys to seen and stack; compare seen count with room count.
Graph traversal reaches exactly the rooms unlockable by a chain of keys.
editorial: Graph traversal reaches exactly the rooms unlockable by a chain of keys.

tests.explanation: The keys form a chain reaching every room.
Room two is never reached from room zero.
